note: Kindfolks kit tokens. Palette names (source: onest / functional / shade) are the 32 colours of the 19 Nov 2026 step-2 record; role names are the 24 both apps carry with the same value. Values are opaque hex; an alpha is applied at the use site.

tokens.name: --kf-palette-deep-green
tokens.role: Brand chrome, active and primary fills, brand text

tokens.name: --kf-palette-cream
tokens.role: Page background; text on deep green

tokens.name: --kf-palette-lime
tokens.role: Only ever on deep green: the active marker, "folks" on dark, badges on deep green

tokens.name: --kf-palette-sage
tokens.role: onest brand pill fill; a light comparison series

tokens.name: --kf-palette-olive
tokens.role: Quiet olive edges (a past milestone); never text

tokens.name: --kf-palette-beige
tokens.role: Outlines: cards, controls, pills, chart rules

tokens.name: --kf-palette-brown
tokens.role: At-risk and warning marks, stars, the current step; never text

tokens.name: --kf-palette-ink
tokens.role: Primary text; scrims, shadows and gridlines at alpha

tokens.name: --kf-palette-white
tokens.role: Surfaces; text on solid coloured fills

tokens.name: --kf-palette-terracotta
tokens.role: Late, overdue, errors, delete: marks and fills. Text only on white or cream

tokens.name: --kf-palette-brown-text
tokens.role: Labels; at-risk and warning text

tokens.name: --kf-palette-olive-strong
tokens.role: On-track and success marks and fills

tokens.name: --kf-palette-deep-green-hover
tokens.role: Hover on a deep-green fill

tokens.name: --kf-palette-sage-light
tokens.role: Selected rows; deep-green pill fills

tokens.name: --kf-palette-olive-tint
tokens.role: On-track and success pill fill

tokens.name: --kf-palette-olive-text
tokens.role: On-track and positive text

tokens.name: --kf-palette-brown-tint
tokens.role: At-risk and warning pill fill

tokens.name: --kf-palette-terracotta-text
tokens.role: Terracotta read as text: late, overdue, errors, delete

tokens.name: --kf-palette-terracotta-deep
tokens.role: Hover on a destructive button

tokens.name: --kf-palette-terracotta-tint
tokens.role: Late and error pill fill

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-1
tokens.role: Hover on surfaces; quiet chips

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-2
tokens.role: Muted fills, progress tracks, inner sections

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-3
tokens.role: The lightest hairline: dividers inside cards and forms, skeletons

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-4
tokens.role: The heavier hairline

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-5
tokens.role: Faint outlines; settled and not-started dots

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-6
tokens.role: Faintest notes (3:1 on white): separators, history notes

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-7
tokens.role: Neutral marks, muted outlines

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-8
tokens.role: Hints, placeholders, empty values

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-9
tokens.role: Secondary text; a target line, drawn dashed

tokens.name: --kf-palette-warm-10
tokens.role: Text on neutral pills

tokens.name: --kf-palette-on-green-muted
tokens.role: Secondary text on deep green

tokens.name: --kf-palette-on-green-faint
tokens.role: Faint text on deep green: group labels, archived rows

tokens.name: --kf-bg-page
tokens.role: Page background

tokens.name: --kf-bg-surface
tokens.role: Cards, panels, modals, inputs

tokens.name: --kf-bg-muted

tokens.name: --kf-bg-brand
tokens.role: Brand fill: sidebar, app chrome, avatar; the browser theme colour

tokens.name: --kf-bg-selected
tokens.role: A selected row or segment (solid)

tokens.name: --kf-bg-active
tokens.role: The active control: chosen view, filter, toggle segment, radio

tokens.name: --kf-text-primary
tokens.role: Primary text

tokens.name: --kf-text-muted

tokens.name: --kf-text-hint

tokens.name: --kf-text-accent
